abstract: This paper examines the relationships between chemical use, namely fertilisers and pesticides, and the production risk of conventional maize in Northern Italy. Using data from the Italian Farm Accountancy Data Network for the period 2015–2020, merged with a station‐based weather dataset, we analyse the production risk through moments of farm‐level yield and revenue probability distributions, namely the mean, variance, negative semi‐variance, skewness and lower partial skewness. Our empirical results, which are robust to potential unobserved confounders, show that higher fertiliser application is correlated with a lower downside risk for per‐hectare revenue and higher spending on pesticides is associated with an increase in expected yield. Furthermore, our results also reveal a negative relationship between crop exposure to extreme heat and the variance of per‐hectare revenue. The findings suggest a potential trade‐off in reducing pesticide use to meet the European Union's agricultural sustainability goals, as lower application of pesticides may lower average production.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了意大利北部常规玉米生产中化学品使用（即化肥和农药）与生产风险之间的关系。我们使用2015—2020年意大利农场会计数据网络的数据，并将其与基于气象站点的天气数据集合并，通过农场层面产量和收入概率分布的矩来分析生产风险，即均值、方差、负半方差、偏度和下偏度。我们的实证结果对潜在未观测混杂因素具有稳健性，表明较高的化肥施用量与每公顷收入的下行风险较低相关，而较高的农药支出与预期产量增加相关。此外，我们的结果还揭示了作物暴露于极端高温与每公顷收入方差之间存在负相关关系。研究结果表明，在实现欧盟农业可持续发展目标的过程中，减少农药使用可能存在潜在权衡，因为较低的农药施用量可能会降低平均产量。
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: Does Chemical Use Mitigate or Exacerbate Production Risk? Evidence From Conventional Maize Farms in Northern Italy

abstract: We summarize the development of consumer economics and food demand in the Journal of Agricultural Economics over the past 100 years. Even from an early stage, the role of marketing agricultural products in a thriving agricultural sector was recognized within the works published in the Journal. Early papers focused on the demand for specific commodities and consumer trends more generally. Over time, analyses became more advanced, diving into the development of theory and methods for the estimation of demand systems. While this trend has continued, other topics have come to the forefront, such as consumer demand for food quality and safety, consumer acceptance of novel technologies, the demand for sustainable food products, and the role of nutrition and health in consumer studies. Methods were developed concurrently to address the new challenges that the agricultural sector faced, from secondary data analysis to primary data collection and experimental methods.
abstract_zh: 我们总结了《农业经济学杂志》过去100年中消费者经济学和食品需求的发展。即使在早期阶段，该杂志发表的作品就已认识到农产品营销在繁荣的农业部门中的作用。早期论文更侧重于特定商品的需求和更广泛的消费者趋势。随着时间的推移，分析变得更加先进，深入探讨了需求系统估计的理论和方法的发展。尽管这一趋势仍在延续，但其他主题已走到前沿，例如消费者对食品质量和安全的需求、消费者对新型技术的接受、对可持续食品的需求，以及营养和健康在消费者研究中的作用。与此同时，方法也得到了发展，以应对农业部门面临的新挑战，从二手数据分析到原始数据收集和实验方法。
title:
Pushing the Boundaries: Studies on Consumers and Food Demand in the
                    Journal of Agricultural Economics
title_zh: 拓展边界：《农业经济学杂志》中关于消费者与食品需求的研究

abstract: Preserving ecosystem services, along with economic and environmental benefits, will require future landscape policies to identify and incorporate relevant landscape features. In this paper, we investigate the causal effect of agricultural landscape simplification on drought‐related grassland damages. We use a novel remote‐sensing product to measure spatial variations in unproductive grassland due to compound drought and heatwave events, and relate it to a landscape metric measuring agricultural land use heterogeneity. Our causal identification strategy employs a spatially explicit fuzzy Regression Discontinuity Design, leveraging Germany's former inner border as an exogenous predictor of agricultural landscape simplification intensity. We find that decreasing agricultural land use heterogeneity increases the share of grasslands rendered unproductive by the drought. Our results suggest that landscape simplification can undermine drought resistance by affecting water availability, decreasing grassland dry matter yields. Overall, this study emphasizes how landscape‐scale heterogeneity can increase ecosystem functionality and farm resilience. Further empirical research on landscape characteristics should enhance understanding of drought mechanisms to increase resistance across land use systems.
abstract_zh: 保护生态系统服务以及经济和环境效益，将要求未来的景观政策识别并纳入相关的景观特征。本文研究了农业景观简化对干旱相关草地损害的因果效应。我们使用一种新型遥感产品来测量复合干旱和热浪事件导致的非生产性草地的空间变化，并将其与衡量农业土地利用异质性的景观指标相关联。我们的因果识别策略采用空间显式的模糊回归断点设计，利用德国前内部边界作为农业景观简化强度的外生预测因子。我们发现，农业土地利用异质性的降低增加了因干旱而变得非生产性的草地比例。我们的结果表明，景观简化可能通过影响水资源可利用量、降低草地干物质产量，从而削弱抗旱能力。总体而言，本研究强调了景观尺度异质性如何能够增强生态系统功能和农场韧性。关于景观特征的进一步实证研究应增进对干旱机制的理解，以提高各土地利用系统的抗性。
title: The causal effect of agricultural landscape simplification on Germany's grasslands during a compound drought and heatwave in 2018
title_zh: 2018年复合干旱和热浪期间农业景观简化对德国草原的因果效应

abstract: A retailer can boost demand for a manufacturer's product through non‐verifiable activities. Performance‐based trade allowances—rebates conditional on the retailer's successful sales efforts—help mitigate this moral hazard problem. In equilibrium, the wholesale contract includes a retail price set below cost, complemented by a rebate for incremental units purchased when efforts successfully increase sales. Loss leading thus emerges as an incentive mechanism, rather than a practice driven by anti‐competitive or exploitative intent. A ban on below‐cost pricing leads to higher retail prices and reduced promotional efforts.
abstract_zh: 零售商可以通过不可验证的活动提升制造商产品的需求。基于绩效的贸易补贴——即以零售商成功销售努力为条件的返利——有助于缓解这一道德风险问题。在均衡状态下，批发合同包含低于成本的零售价格，并辅以当努力成功提升销售时对增量购买单位给予的返利。因此，亏损领先作为一种激励机制出现，而非由反竞争或剥削意图驱动的行为。对低于成本定价的禁令会导致更高的零售价格和减少的促销努力。
title: The Incentive Virtues of Performance‐Based Trade Allowances and Loss Leading
title_zh: 基于绩效的贸易补贴与亏损领先的激励优势

abstract: A joint savings group, JSG, is a form of micro-financing by which people who have limited or no access to formal financial markets can expedite the acquisition of a desired (often indivisible) good. Because typically multiple arrangements of joint saving are feasible, a rule is needed for admitting group formations that bring the expected waiting time to a minimum and rejecting group formations that do not: when people form a JSG, they will want to know the efficient group size. Somewhat surprisingly, the existing literature does not address this need. This lacuna prompted us to develop an analytical framework that yielded the following rule: for a given number of co-savers, N, and a given cost of the desired good, C, the efficient sets of JSGs are sets in each of which every group except for at most one group is of a size that is a multiple of C. Analyzing the robustness of our rule to a change in N and C, we find that the number of efficient sets of JSGs does not change monotonically with respect to N and C. In particular, an increase in N and a decrease in C may actually decrease the number of efficient sets of JSGs.
abstract_zh: 联合储蓄小组（JSG）是一种微型融资形式，通过它，那些对正规金融市场准入有限或无法进入的人可以加快获得所需（通常不可分割）商品的速度。由于通常存在多种可行的联合储蓄安排，因此需要一条规则来接纳能使预期等待时间最小化的群体形成，并拒绝不能做到这一点的群体形成：当人们组成JSG时，他们会想知道有效率的群体规模。颇为令人意外的是，现有文献并未涉及这一需求。这一空白促使我们开发了一个分析框架，并得出了以下规则：对于给定的共同储蓄者人数N和给定所需商品的成本C，有效率的JSG集合是这样一些集合，在每一个集合中，除至多一个群体外，每个群体的规模都是C的倍数。在分析我们的规则对N和C变化的稳健性时，我们发现，有效JSG集合的数量并不会相对于N和C单调变化。特别是，N的增加和C的减少实际上可能会减少有效JSG集合的数量。
title: On the optimal size of a joint savings association: Part 2 - efficiency
title_zh: 论联合储蓄协会的最优规模：第二部分——效率

abstract: Polarization is an increasingly prevalent issue in environmental conflicts, often simplified as two opposing arguments. However, most studies lack theoretical conceptualizations of polarization to reveal its complexity, drivers, and effects. By combining concepts of polarization with discourse analysis, this study provides a nuanced perspective on the social construction of land-use conflicts and their surrounding polarization. It demonstrates how disentangling underlying drivers and power relations enhances the understanding of conflicts, considering their context-specificity. To this end, I empirically scrutinize the factors of the deep-rooted conflict between forestry and nature conservation in Germany. The analysis focuses on public and political debates between 2018 and 2020 on forests affected by climate change. Large-scale forest damage has sparked controversy over whether to actively adapt forests or rely on the ecosystem’s self-regulation. While both sides instrumentalize climate change to emphasize the urgency of their measures to ‘save’ the forests and make them climate-resilient, the results demonstrate the entanglements of narratives and subject positions beyond this dichotomy. Rather than being issue-related, polarization is mainly driven by affective sentiments toward pre-constructed actor groups that are discursively reproduced. Polarization is further reinforced through perceived polarization, expressed through simplifications, generalizations, misconceptions, and dismissive reframing of opposing arguments. Instead of taking the negative effects of polarization for granted, the discussion highlights the need for research to critically reflect on the dynamics of polarization and the ways in which it manifests. This understanding is crucial for resolving entrenched debates, unfolding the generative potential of conflict, and allowing alternative solutions to emerge.
abstract_zh: 极化在环境冲突中日益普遍，常被简化为两种对立的论点。然而，多数研究缺乏对极化的理论概念化，难以揭示其复杂性、驱动因素与影响。本研究将极化概念与话语分析相结合，为土地利用冲突及其周边极化的社会建构提供了细致入微的视角。研究展示，梳理潜在驱动因素与权力关系如何能够增进对冲突的理解，并兼顾其情境特殊性。为此，我对德国林业与自然保护之间根深蒂固冲突的因素进行了实证审视。分析聚焦于2018年至2020年间围绕受气候变化影响森林的公共与政治辩论。大规模森林损害引发了争议：是主动适应森林，还是依赖生态系统的自我调节。尽管双方都将气候变化工具化，以强调其“拯救”森林并使其具有气候韧性之措施的紧迫性，但研究结果揭示了超越这一二分法的叙事与主体位置的纠缠。极化主要并非议题相关，而是由对预先建构的行动者群体的情感情绪所驱动，这些群体在话语中被再生产。极化还通过感知到的极化而进一步强化，表现为简化、概括、误解以及对对立论点的贬斥性重构。讨论并未将极化的负面效应视为理所当然，而是强调研究需要批判性地反思极化的动态及其表现形式。这种理解对于解决根深蒂固的争论、展开冲突的生成性潜力，并使替代性解决方案得以涌现，至关重要。
title: (Un)polarized forests? Disentangling drivers of polarization in the public debate around German forests affected by climate change
title_zh: （去）极化的森林？解析受气候变化影响的德国森林公众辩论中极化的驱动因素

abstract: We characterise sabotage, exemplified by recent US policies concerning China’s semiconductor industry, as trade policy. For some (but not all) goods, completely destroying foreigners’ productivity increases domestic real income by shifting the location of production and improving the terms of trade. The gross benefit of sabotage can be summarised by a few sufficient statistics: trade and demand elasticities and import and production shares. The cost of sabotage is determined by countries’ relative unit labour costs for the sabotaged goods. We find important non-monotonicities: for semiconductors, partially sabotaging foreign production would lower US real income, while comprehensive sabotage would raise it.
abstract_zh: 我们将破坏行为——以近期美国针对中国半导体产业的政策为例——界定为一种贸易政策。对于某些（但并非所有）商品而言，完全摧毁外国的生产能力可通过改变生产区位和改善贸易条件来提高本国实际收入。破坏行为的总收益可由少数充分统计量来概括：贸易与需求弹性以及进口份额和生产份额。破坏行为的成本取决于各国在受破坏商品上的相对单位劳动成本。我们发现存在重要的非单调性：就半导体而言，部分破坏外国生产会降低美国实际收入，而全面破坏则会提高美国实际收入。

abstract: This study examines the effects of a government bailout on corporate disclosure when a firm is exposed to the risk of investors withdrawing their investments from the firm. The government bailout affects the behavior of investors, which, in turn, alters the disclosure behavior of the firm. We find that the firm discloses less (more) than the case without a bailout when investors have pessimistic (optimistic) beliefs about the firm. These changes in disclosure decision reduce investors’ expectations about the firm’s fundamentals. Therefore, the government bailout can increase the likelihood of the firm facing a liquidity crisis if it distorts the disclosure behavior of the firm.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了当企业面临投资者撤资风险时，政府救助对企业信息披露的影响。政府救助会改变投资者行为，进而改变企业的披露行为。我们发现，当投资者对企业持悲观（乐观）信念时，企业披露的信息少于（多于）无救助情形。这些披露决策的变化降低了投资者对企业基本面的预期。因此，如果政府救助扭曲了企业的披露行为，则可能增加企业面临流动性危机的可能性。
title: Corporate disclosure, government bailout, and liquidity crisis

abstract: Accurate tail index estimation is critical for measuring extreme risk in economic and financial systems. We propose a closed-form estimator, the Method of Truncated Moments (MTM), based on matching empirical and theoretical truncated moments. Unlike classical approaches, our method jointly determines the tail index and optimal tail region threshold, which reduces sensitivity to tuning parameters. MTM is asymptotically valid for regularly varying tails and offers an accuracy superior to modern benchmarks. It performs robustly in small samples and remains stable even when convergence to the Pareto limit is slow.
abstract_zh: 准确的尾部指数估计对于度量经济与金融系统中的极端风险至关重要。我们提出了一种闭式估计量，即截断矩方法（MTM），其基于匹配经验截断矩与理论截断矩。与经典方法不同，我们的方法能够同时确定尾部指数和最优尾部区域阈值，从而降低了对调参参数的敏感性。MTM对于正则变化尾部具有渐近有效性，并且其精度优于现代基准方法。它在小样本中表现稳健，即使向帕累托极限的收敛较慢时也依然保持稳定。
title: Harness the power law: Robust estimation of tail index and threshold
title_zh: 利用幂律：尾部指数与阈值的稳健估计

abstract: This paper offers new empirical insights into the relationship between the European fiscal framework and the cyclical stance of fiscal policy in EMU countries. By employing a Time-Varying Coefficient (TVC) model, we generate country- and year-specific measures of fiscal cyclicality from 1995 to 2019. We then quantify the evolving intensity of fiscal rules through a country- and year-specific composite index and examine its relationship with fiscal cyclicality via panel regressions with multiple estimators, including a robust IV-GMM specification that addresses endogeneity concerns. This dual-framework strategy enables us to capture the distortion introduced by real-time revisions and identify a significant procyclical bias in peripheral countries, which is largely masked when ex post data are used. In other words, our findings reveal a marked asymmetry: while the estimated relationship between fiscal rules and cyclicality is neutral or mildly countercyclical in core countries, it is significantly procyclical in peripheral ones when real-time data are considered. These results have important implications for the revised European fiscal framework, as the new indicator (i.e., net expenditure) continues to rely on cycle-sensitive variables and may therefore perpetuate the same structural basis. Our analysis calls for a deeper reconsideration of the methodology used to estimate potential output in the EU. By demonstrating how the interaction between fiscal rules and real-time macroeconomic estimates can generate unintended policy outcomes, this study contributes to a more informed debate on the future of fiscal governance in the euro area.
abstract_zh: 本文为欧洲财政框架与欧洲经济货币联盟（EMU）国家财政政策周期性立场之间的关系提供了新的经验证据。通过采用时变系数（TVC）模型，我们生成了1995年至2019年国别和年份特定的财政周期性度量。随后，我们通过一个国别和年份特定的综合指数量化了财政规则不断演变的强度，并通过多种估计量的面板回归考察其与财政周期性的关系，其中包括一个稳健的IV-GMM设定，以处理内生性问题。这一双重框架策略使我们能够捕捉实时修正所引入的扭曲，并识别出外围国家中显著的顺周期偏向，而这一偏向在使用事后数据时在很大程度上被掩盖。换言之，我们的发现揭示了一种显著的不对称性：在核心国家中，财政规则与周期性之间的估计关系为中性或温和逆周期，而在外围国家中，当考虑实时数据时，该关系则显著为顺周期。这些结果对修订后的欧洲财政框架具有重要意义，因为新指标（即净支出）仍然依赖于对周期敏感的变量，因而可能延续相同的结构性基础。我们的分析呼吁对欧盟潜在产出估算方法进行更深入的重新审视。通过展示财政规则与实时宏观经济估算之间的相互作用如何产生非预期的政策结果，本研究为关于欧元区财政治理未来的讨论提供了更为知情的贡献。
title: A time-varying approach to assessing fiscal cyclicality: The role of the European fiscal framework#
title_zh: 评估财政周期性的时变方法：欧洲财政框架的作用

abstract: We examine how corporate financial constraints shape firms’ employment responses to minimum wage policies. Exploiting the federal minimum wage increase during the financial crisis and variation in firms’ debt maturity structures at the crisis onset, we find that financially constrained firms significantly reduce employment. To assess external validity, we analyze staggered state-level minimum wage increases over time. Consistent with the crisis evidence, employment declines in establishments of constrained firms, whereas unconstrained firms expand in areas with a larger supply of minimum-wage workers and higher turnover. Our results highlight the central role of financial constraints in mediating labor policy effects.
abstract_zh: 我们考察企业融资约束如何影响其对最低工资政策的就业反应。利用金融危机期间联邦最低工资上调以及危机爆发时企业债务期限结构的差异，我们发现融资约束型企业会显著减少就业。为评估外部有效性，我们分析了各州最低工资随时间交错上调的情况。与金融危机期间的证据一致，受约束企业的机构就业下降，而未受约束企业则在最低工资劳动者供给更多、流动率更高的地区扩张。我们的结果凸显了融资约束在调节劳动政策效应中的核心作用。
title: Corporate Financial Constraints, Minimum Wage Policies, and Employment
title_zh: 企业融资约束、最低工资政策与就业

abstract: An extensive body of research has documented that firms play an important role in wage inequality. However, much less is known about how firm pay differentials translate into household spending, and under what conditions those spending differences map into welfare differences. In this paper, we combine newly collected expenditure data with employer-employee records from Norway to examine how firm pay inequality is transmitted to household spending. We show that when workers move up the firm pay ladder, the resulting increase in spending is roughly half of the increase in disposable income: the implied marginal propensity to consume (MPC out of income) is approximately 0.5. These spending responses are highly persistent. The response is concentrated in discretionary and housing-related spending: hotel stays display the largest relative response, while housing-related expenditures account for the largest share of the aggregate MPC. Next, we decompose wages and spending into worker- and firm-level components, and find that firms account for roughly half the variance in consumption inequality relative to wages. Finally, a search model with consumption-savings decisions reproduces these results and shows that firm-level consumption differences closely track firms’ contribution to welfare inequality. Our findings thus indicate that firms play an important role not only in wage inequality but also in welfare inequality.
abstract_zh: 大量研究已记录企业在工资不平等中发挥重要作用。然而，关于企业工资差异如何转化为家庭支出，以及在何种条件下这些支出差异会映射为福利差异，人们所知甚少。本文结合新收集的支出数据与挪威的雇主-雇员记录，考察企业工资不平等如何传导至家庭支出。我们表明，当工人沿企业工资阶梯向上流动时，由此带来的支出增加约为可支配收入增加的一半：隐含的边际消费倾向（收入MPC）约为0.5。这些支出反应具有高度持续性。反应集中于可自由支配支出和住房相关支出：酒店住宿显示出最大的相对反应，而住房相关支出在总体MPC中占比最大。接下来，我们将工资和支出分解为工人层面和企业层面成分，发现相对于工资，企业约占消费不平等方差的的一半。最后，一个包含消费-储蓄决策的搜寻模型复现了这些结果，并表明企业层面的消费差异密切追踪企业对福利不平等的贡献。因此，我们的发现表明，企业不仅在工资不平等中，也在福利不平等中发挥重要作用。
title: Firm Pay and Consumption Inequality
title_zh: 企业薪酬与消费不平等

abstract: This paper analyzes foreign demand for U.S. assets, with particular emphasis on U.S. Treasury securities. It documents compositional shifts in U.S. bilateral external positions across geographic regions and asset classes, providing estimates of creditor positions closer to a nationality-based concept. While rising U.S. equity prices explain a sizable share of the deterioration in the net external position, foreign purchases of U.S. Treasury securities have been the largest source of U.S. current account financing. The share of these securities held by foreign official investors has declined sharply during the past decade, while the share held by foreign private investors (especially through financial centers) has risen. The decline in foreign official holdings is well explained by lower reserve accumulation, increased Federal Reserve holdings, and dollar appreciation against other reserve currencies. The evidence is consistent with central banks rebalancing their portfolios to avoid large swings in currency shares. Geoeconomic fragmentation is negatively correlated with official demand for U.S. Treasuries, while foreign private demand remains sensitive to safe-haven dynamics. Overall, the paper assesses how these structural shifts affect portfolio preferences for U.S. assets and their potential implications for the U.S. external position amid heightened geopolitical and fiscal uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了外国对美国资产的需求，尤其侧重于美国国债。本文记录了美国双边外部头寸在地理区域和资产类别之间的构成变化，并提供了更接近基于国籍概念的债权人头寸估计。尽管美国股票价格上涨解释了净外部头寸恶化的相当大一部分，但外国对美国国债的购买一直是美国经常账户融资的最大来源。过去十年中，外国官方投资者持有这些证券的份额大幅下降，而外国私人投资者（尤其是通过金融中心）持有的份额则有所上升。外国官方持有量的下降可由储备积累减少、美联储持有量增加以及美元相对于其他储备货币升值得到很好的解释。这些证据与各国央行调整其投资组合以避免货币份额大幅波动的行为相一致。地缘经济碎片化与对美国国债的官方需求呈负相关，而外国私人需求则仍然对避险动态保持敏感。总体而言，本文评估了这些结构性变化如何影响对美国资产的投资组合偏好，以及它们在地缘政治和财政不确定性加剧之际对美国外部头寸的潜在影响。

title: The United States and Its Creditors: Assessing Foreign Demand for U.S. Assets
title_zh: 美国及其债权人：评估外国对美国资产的需求

abstract: In the late nineteenth century, Americans feared that crowded immigrant neighborhoods were spreading disease through industrial cities. We study this claim using newly constructed town-level panel data from Massachusetts, 1860 to 1915, a setting uniquely suited to this exercise because its early vital registration system allows consistent measurement of mortality before national registration became widespread. Using a shift-share instrumental variable strategy based on historical settlement patterns, we estimate the effect of local exposure to immigration on mortality. The relevant question is not whether immigrant families themselves experienced higher mortality, but whether immigration altered the local disease environment more broadly. We find that increases in the foreign-born share significantly raised infant and child mortality, with the infant effect falling disproportionately on the post-neonatal period. Mechanical changes in the composition of births by parent nativity account for only a portion of the estimated effect, implying that the results are not driven primarily by higher mortality among immigrant births. Instead, the evidence is consistent with increased exposure to immigrants, communicable disease, and spillovers to children of native-born parents. These findings highlight immigration as one factor shaping the mortality transition in crowded high-mortality environments.
abstract_zh: 在19世纪末，美国人担心拥挤的移民社区正在通过工业城市传播疾病。我们利用新构建的马萨诸塞州1860年至1915年城镇层面面板数据来研究这一说法，该背景特别适合此项研究，因为其早期生命登记系统使得在全国性登记普及之前能够一致地测量死亡率。我们采用基于历史定居模式的份额移动工具变量策略，估计当地移民暴露对死亡率的影响。相关问题不在于移民家庭本身是否经历了更高的死亡率，而在于移民是否更广泛地改变了当地的疾病环境。我们发现，外国出生人口比例的增加显著提高了婴儿和儿童死亡率，其中婴儿效应不成比例地落在新生儿后期。出生构成因父母出生地而发生的机械性变化仅解释了估计效应的一部分，这意味着结果并非主要由移民出生婴儿的更高死亡率所驱动。相反，证据与移民、传染病暴露增加以及对本土出生父母子女的溢出效应相一致。这些发现凸显了移民是塑造拥挤高死亡率环境中死亡率转变的一个因素。

title: Immigration and Child Mortality During the Age of Mass Migration

abstract: This paper examines innovation outcomes before and after 1,200 startup acquisitions by eight major technology firms. Linking patent and workforce data to these deals, we document four main findings. First, most acquired startups hold no patents, but those with patents tend to operate in technology areas where the acquirer already has a presence and that see further acquisition activity. Second, innovation typically rises before an acquisition, continues afterward only where further acquisitions follow, and falls back once acquisition activity ends. We propose a stylized model in which beliefs about commercial viability drive both startup entry and acquisitions to explain how these patterns arise through selection rather than effects of the deals. Third, acquired patents receive significantly more citations after the acquisition than comparable patents, not only from the acquirer but also from firms that hire the targets' employees. Fourth, although 31% of employees and 23% of inventors depart within a year, inventors who stay go on to patent substantially more, while stayers and leavers were equally productive beforehand. In the aggregate, we find little evidence that acquisitions by digital incumbents suppress innovation, even though serial acquisitions go hand in hand with growing patent consolidation.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了八家大型科技公司进行的1200起初创企业收购前后的创新结果。通过将专利和劳动力数据与这些交易相链接，我们记录了四个主要发现。第一，大多数被收购的初创企业不持有专利，但那些拥有专利的企业往往在收购方已有布局、且后续收购活动较多的技术领域运营。第二，创新通常在收购前上升，仅在后续收购继续发生时于收购后持续，而一旦收购活动结束便回落。我们提出一个风格化模型，其中对商业可行性的信念同时驱动初创企业进入和收购，以解释这些模式如何通过选择而非交易效应产生。第三，被收购专利在收购后获得的引用显著多于可比专利，不仅来自收购方，也来自雇佣目标企业员工的公司。第四，尽管31%的员工和23%的发明人在一年内离职，留下来的发明人随后申请的专利大幅增加，而留下者和离职者在此之前的生产率相同。总体而言，我们几乎没有发现证据表明数字 incumbent 的收购抑制了创新，尽管连续收购与日益加剧的专利集中相伴而行。
title: Digital (Killer?) Acquisitions
title_zh: 数字（杀手？）收购

abstract: Many countries combine carbon pricing with renewable-energy policies. Microeconomic theory predicts this combination yields no additional emissions reductions under cap-and-trade and only potentially under carbon taxation, but at a social welfare loss. We undertook a systematic literature review of emissions-reduction synergy, identifying many ex-ante but only one ex-post study – explained by the lack of policy counterfactuals. In 72% of ex-ante 127 estimates from 80 studies, combining instruments reduces emissions more than either instrument alone. Additional reductions are more common under carbon taxation, as theory predicts, but also occur under cap-and-trade. Across 85 exact synergy estimates, the policy combination yields about 22% greater emissions reductions on average. Regarding welfare effects, 74 of 119 ex-ante estimates from 79 papers indicate some benefit from adding a second instrument. Deviations from theory reflect model assumptions, such as incomplete emissions coverage, implementation constraints, social welfare metrics limited to consumer utility, and market or government failures including fossil fuel subsidies. While ex-post estimates are less likely to detect non-zero synergy, the single ex-post study broadly supports our findings.
abstract_zh: 许多国家将碳定价与可再生能源政策相结合。微观经济理论预测，在总量管制与交易制度下，这种组合不会带来额外的减排，只有在碳税制度下才可能带来额外减排，但会伴随社会福利损失。我们对减排协同效应进行了系统性文献综述，识别出大量事前研究，但仅有一项事后研究——其原因在于缺乏政策反事实。在来自80项研究的127个事前估计中，72%表明政策工具组合比任一单一工具实现更多减排。额外减排在碳税制度下更为常见，正如理论所预测，但在总量管制与交易制度下也会出现。在85个精确协同效应估计中，政策组合平均带来约22%的额外减排。关于福利效应，来自79篇论文的119个事前估计中有74个表明，增加第二项工具会带来一定收益。与理论的偏离反映了模型假设，例如排放覆盖不完整、实施约束、仅限于消费者效用的社会福利指标，以及包括化石燃料补贴在内的市场或政府失灵。尽管事后估计更不容易检测到非零协同效应，但唯一一项事后研究总体上支持我们的发现。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Synergies and Welfare Effects of Combining Carbon Pricing and Renewable-Energy Policies: A Meta-Analysis

abstract: We study firm turnover (i.e., entry and exit) and its consumer implications in a market characterized by asymmetric information. Using a three‐round census of agro‐dealers in Tanzania's Morogoro Region, we document annual firm entry and exit rates of 33% and 17%, respectively. These rates are more than double those observed for non‐agricultural micro‐, small‐, and medium‐enterprises in comparable low‐income countries. To analyze how these high rates of entry and exit affect consumers, we develop a theoretical model of firm turnover under asymmetric information and empirically test its predictions for farmers. We find that farmers' market‐level beliefs about agricultural input quality are systematically related to agro‐dealer turnover, with the relationship depending on farmers' prior perceptions of market quality. Farmers report more favorable beliefs about agricultural input quality in markets with recent agro‐dealer exits, consistent with our model when consumers perceive exiting firms as having sold low‐quality products. In contrast, farmers who usually purchased agricultural inputs from the same agro‐dealer expect new market entrants to provide lower‐quality agricultural inputs, suggesting farmers rely on incumbent relationships to manage quality uncertainty in markets with information asymmetries. As a result, agro‐dealer turnover may shape and even attenuate farmers' technology adoption.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在信息不对称特征市场中企业更替（即进入与退出）及其对消费者的影响。利用坦桑尼亚莫罗戈罗地区农资经销商的三轮普查数据，我们记录了年度企业进入率和退出率分别为33%和17%。这些比率是可比的低收入国家中非农业微型、小型和中型企业所观察到的比率的两倍以上。为分析这些高进入率和退出率如何影响消费者，我们构建了一个信息不对称下企业更替的理论模型，并针对农民对其预测进行了实证检验。我们发现，农民对农业投入品质量的市场层面信念与农资经销商更替存在系统性关联，且这种关系取决于农民对市场质量的先前认知。在近期有农资经销商退出的市场中，农民报告对农业投入品质量持有更有利的信念，这与我们的模型一致，即消费者认为退出企业销售了低质量产品。相比之下，通常从同一农资经销商购买农业投入品的农民预期新市场进入者会提供质量更低的农业投入品，这表明农民依赖既有关系来管理信息不对称市场中的质量不确定性。因此，农资经销商更替可能塑造甚至削弱农民的技术采纳。
title: Firm turnover under asymmetric information: Tanzania's agro‐dealer sector

abstract: This paper estimates a New Keynesian model with new and old behavioral elements. Agents in the model exhibit cognitive discounting, or myopia: they discount variables far into the future at higher rates than typically implied in the benchmark model. We investigate the model under different expectational assumptions: rational expectations, subjective expectations with infinite‐horizon learning, and subjective expectations with Euler‐equation learning. Under rational expectations, the model necessitates of large, possibly unrealistically so, degrees of myopia. The same result persists under infinite‐horizon learning, given that agents are still remarkably far‐sighted. But, under Euler‐equation learning, the model can fit the data with only minimal estimated degrees of myopia. The results indicate that the empirical evidence for cognitive discounting may be sensitive to the modeling of expectations, and they highlight learning as a key behavioral feature to understand macro‐economic fluctuations.
abstract_zh: 本文估计了一个包含新旧行为要素的新凯恩斯模型。模型中的主体表现出认知贴现或短视：他们对遥远未来的变量进行贴现的比率高于基准模型中通常隐含的比率。我们在不同的预期假设下考察该模型：理性预期、具有无限期学习的 subjective expectations，以及具有欧拉方程学习的主观预期。在理性预期下，该模型需要很大程度的短视，甚至可能大到不现实的程度。在无限期学习下，同样的结果依然存在，因为主体仍然显著地具有远见。但在欧拉方程学习下，该模型仅需估计出极小的短视程度就能拟合数据。结果表明，认知贴现的经验证据可能对预期的建模方式敏感，并凸显了学习作为理解宏观经济波动的关键行为特征。

abstract: Information mismatches between industrial financing demand and the supply of financial resources constrain entrepreneurial actors’ market entry. Taking China’s industry–finance collaboration pilot policy as a quasi-natural experiment, this study uses panel data from 289 Chinese cities over the period 2010–2023 and applies a staggered difference-in-differences approach to examine its impact on regional entrepreneurial activity. The results show that industry–finance collaboration significantly enhances regional entrepreneurial activity, and this finding remains robust across a series of checks. Mechanism analysis indicates that industry–finance collaboration affects regional entrepreneurial activity through three channels: financing constraint alleviation, technological innovation, and talent agglomeration. Financing constraint alleviation and technological innovation play more prominent roles than talent agglomeration. Heterogeneity analysis shows that the policy effect is more pronounced in small cities, cities in western China, and the tertiary sector, suggesting that this effect is shaped by cities’ development foundations, regional financial resource endowments, and industry-specific entry characteristics. From the perspective of information matching and factor allocation, this study reveals the mechanisms through which industry–finance collaboration affects regional entrepreneurial activity and provides empirical evidence for developing countries to formulate financial support policies. abstract_zh: 产业融资需求与金融资源供给之间的信息错配制约了创业主体的市场进入。本文以中国产融合作试点政策作为准自然实验，采用2010—2023年中国289个城市的面板数据，运用交错双重差分方法考察其对区域创业活动的影响。结果表明，产融合作显著提升了区域创业活动，且该结论在一系列检验中保持稳健。机制分析表明，产融合作通过融资约束缓解、技术创新和人才集聚三条渠道影响区域创业活动，其中融资约束缓解和技术创新的作用比人才集聚更为突出。异质性分析显示，该政策效应在小城市、中国西部城市和第三产业中更为明显，表明这一效应受到城市发展基础、区域金融资源禀赋和行业特定进入特征的影响。本文从信息匹配与要素配置的视角揭示了产融合作影响区域创业活动的机制，并为发展中国家制定金融支持政策提供了经验证据。关键词：产融合作；创业活动；信息错配；要素配置。JEL分类号：G28；O31。

abstract: We develop a big data methodology to estimate true stock prices and liquidity, explicitly accounting for rounding effects from the minimum tick size. Applying this approach to the tick size pilot (TSP), which increased the tick size for randomly selected stocks, we find that the TSP boosts market maker profits but does not enhance liquidity. This result aligns with theoretical predictions but contrasts with prior empirical studies. Our rounding-adjusted liquidity measures capture TSP-induced trading restrictions and reduced inventory holdings of market makers while exhibiting less dispersion across exchanges, thus validating our methodology and the accuracy of our measures.
abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种大数据方法，用于估计真实股票价格和流动性，并明确考虑了最小报价单位带来的舍入效应。将这一方法应用于最小报价单位试点（TSP）——该试点提高了随机选取股票的最小报价单位——我们发现，TSP提高了做市商利润，但并未增强流动性。这一结果与理论预测一致，但与既有实证研究形成对比。我们经舍入调整的流动性指标捕捉到了TSP引发的交易限制以及做市商存货持有量的下降，同时在交易所之间的离散度更小，从而验证了我们的方法及指标准确性。
title: True liquidity and fundamental prices: U.S. tick size pilot

abstract: We conducted two online survey experiments examining how writing style influences economists’ perceptions of research quality. Participants were randomly assigned to evaluate manuscript cover pages that varied by document editor (Microsoft Word versus LaTeX) and the presence of a spelling or grammar error. In the original experiment, conducted among U.S. economists, spelling and grammar errors significantly reduced perceived research quality, whereas document editor had little effect. In a follow-up experiment, conducted among an international sample of economists, LaTeX use was substantially more common, and manuscripts prepared in LaTeX were generally evaluated more favorably than those prepared in Microsoft Word. Taken together, our findings suggest that careful proofreading and preparing manuscripts in LaTeX are prudent best practices. Depending on the reader, both may improve perceptions of research quality while carrying little or no downside risk.
abstract_zh: 我们开展了两项在线调查实验，考察写作风格如何影响经济学家对研究质量的感知。参与者被随机分配去评价稿件封面页，这些封面页在文档编辑器（Microsoft Word与LaTeX）以及是否存在拼写或语法错误方面有所不同。在最初针对美国经济学家开展的实验中，拼写和语法错误显著降低了感知到的研究质量，而文档编辑器几乎没有影响。在一项针对国际经济学家样本开展的后续实验中，LaTeX的使用要普遍得多，并且用LaTeX准备的稿件通常比用Microsoft Word准备的稿件获得更有利的评价。综合来看，我们的发现表明，仔细校对并使用LaTeX准备稿件是审慎的最佳实践。取决于读者，二者都可能改善对研究质量的感知，同时几乎没有或没有下行风险。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 250
title: Does LaTeX enhance perceptions of research quality in economics?
title_zh: LaTeX是否提升了经济学研究质量的感知？

abstract: We study different notions of consistency in a model of preference aggregation where the feasible set of alternatives may vary. We show that there exists no social choice function (SCF) satisfying contraction consistency (CC), non-dictatorship, and Pareto efficiency (PE). We then characterize a class of priority-based SCFs, called Priority Rules (PRs), in two ways: first, using PE and efficient dominance, a WARP-type consistency condition with respect to PE; and second, using PE, weak contraction consistency, and invariant efficiency. We also characterize Decisive Individual Rules, in which the decisive individual may vary across profiles, using a top-selection condition, a weakening of CC, and an intersection condition on decisive individuals. Finally, in the social choice correspondence (SCC) setting, when the number of alternatives exceeds the number of voters, we characterize Voting by Minimal Committees SCCs using correspondence contraction consistency, top selection, unanimity, and committee intersection.
abstract_zh: 我们研究在一个可行备选集合可能变化的偏好聚合模型中，不同的一致性概念。我们表明，不存在满足收缩一致性（CC）、非独裁性和帕累托效率（PE）的社会选择函数（SCF）。随后，我们以两种方式刻画了一类基于优先权的SCF，称为优先规则（PRs）：第一，使用PE和有效支配，即一种关于PE的WARP型一致性条件；第二，使用PE、弱收缩一致性和不变效率。我们还刻画了决定性个人规则，其中决定性个人可能因偏好剖面而异，使用的是顶部选择条件、CC的一种弱化，以及关于决定性个人的交集条件。最后，在社会选择对应（SCC）框架中，当备选方案数量超过选民数量时，我们使用对应收缩一致性、顶部选择、一致同意和委员会交集来刻画最小委员会投票SCC。
title: Consistency and social choice: Possibilities and impossibilities
title_zh: 一致性与社会选择：可能与不可能

abstract: We study multidimensional mean-preserving contractions (MPC) and their extreme points. Proposition 1 focuses on extreme MPCs of a measure μ: each finitely supported extreme MPC ν induces a partition of X, the domain of μ, into convex sets such that the support of ν on each element of the partition is an affinely independent set, and such that the restriction of ν on each element of the partition is itself an MPC of the restriction of the prior μ on that element. We apply our results to several questions concerning moment persuasion and categorization. In particular, we prove that categories and prototypes (key elements typically assumed to be exogenous in the classical literature on categorization) can endogenously emerge as outcomes of optimization when the decision maker faces limits on the amount of information that she can either acquire or process.
abstract_zh: 我们研究多维均值保持收缩（MPC）及其极值点。命题1聚焦于测度μ的极值MPC：每个有限支撑的极值MPC ν诱导出μ的定义域X的一个凸集划分，使得ν在划分的每个元素上的支撑为仿射无关集，并且ν在划分的每个元素上的限制本身是先验μ在该元素上的限制的MPC。我们将结果应用于若干关于矩说服与分类的问题。特别地，我们证明，当决策者面临其能够获取或处理的信息量限制时，类别与原型（经典分类文献中通常假定为外生的关键要素）可以作为优化的结果内生地出现。
title: The Extreme Points of Mean-Preserving Contractions
title_zh: 保均值收缩的极值点

abstract: The paper shows that population aging can reduce the welfare cost to individuals of a persistent negative local shock, because slower out‐migration restrains forward‐looking capital disinvestment and the retained capital cushions the wages of those who stay. I consider asymmetric capital adjustment: under irreversibility, disinvestment is less elastic than installation. I extend the paper's capital block to allow for this asymmetry and show that the extension can be tractably incorporated into standard dynamic hat algebra solution algorithms, including the one employed in the paper. I then illustrate the importance of asymmetric capital adjustment through a simple one‐region example.
abstract_zh: 本文表明，人口老龄化可以降低持续性负面局部冲击对个人造成的福利成本，因为较慢的向外迁移抑制了前瞻性的资本撤资，而留存的资本为留下者的工资提供了缓冲。我考虑了非对称资本调整：在不可逆性下，撤资比投资缺乏弹性。我扩展了本文的资本模块以允许这种非对称性，并表明该扩展可以被可处理地纳入标准动态帽子代数求解算法，包括本文所采用的那种算法。随后，我通过一个简单的单区域例子说明了非对称资本调整的重要性。
title: Discussion of “Local Shocks and Regional Dynamics in an Aging Economy”—The Downward Elasticity of Regional Capital
title_zh: 评述《老龄化经济中的局部冲击与区域动态》——区域资本的下行弹性

abstract: The 2018 China Initiative by the Trump administration complicated procedures and reduced funding for U.S.‐China research collaborations. Using Scopus data, we analyze its impact on Chinese research. We find that it significantly lowered the quality of both publications and co‐authors of Chinese researchers with prior U.S. collaborations compared to those with prior European collaborations, and reduced yearly citations for affected researchers by 6%. The effect was stronger for high‐productivity Chinese researchers in U.S.‐dominated fields. While China is at the forefront of the scientific frontier, it still depends more on the U.S. than the reverse.
abstract_zh: 特朗普政府2018年发起的“中国行动计划”使美中科研合作的程序复杂化并减少了资助。我们利用Scopus数据分析了该计划对中国科研的影响。我们发现，与先前有欧洲合作的研究者相比，该计划显著降低了先前有美国合作的中国研究者的论文质量及合著者质量，并使受影响研究者的年度引用量减少了6%。这一效应对美国主导领域中的高产出中国研究者更为显著。尽管中国处于科学前沿，但其对美国的依赖仍大于美国对中国的依赖。

abstract: Recent shortages and price volatility have exposed vulnerabilities in international agri-food value chains. This paper develops a new framework for measuring trade diversification based on Hill numbers, which capture both the extensive and intensive margin of trade connections. Using HS6-level bilateral data for 188 countries from 2000 to 2022, I first document global patterns of diversification and concentration across agri-food sectors. The descriptive evidence shows that most countries trade with many partners in principle, yet effectively rely on only a few, especially for grains and oilseeds. I then estimate the effect of import and export diversification on within-year food price volatility using a shift–share instrumental-variable design that exploits exogenous foreign sector-level shocks weighted by lagged bilateral trade exposure. The empirical results show that more balanced and diversified import portfolios are strongly associated with lower food price volatility, whereas export diversification plays a more limited role. Policies encouraging diversification can reduce food price volatility but involve trade-offs between efficiency from international specialization and resilience of the input–output network.
abstract_zh: 近期短缺与价格波动暴露了国际农食价值链的脆弱性。本文基于Hill数构建了一个衡量贸易多样化的新框架，该框架同时捕捉贸易联系的广延边际与集约边际。利用2000年至2022年188个国家HS6位级双边数据，本文首先刻画了农食各行业多样化和集中化的全球格局。描述性证据表明，多数国家原则上与众多伙伴开展贸易，但实际上仅依赖少数伙伴，谷物和油籽尤为突出。随后，本文采用偏移-份额工具变量设计，利用以滞后双边贸易暴露度加权的外国行业层面外生冲击，估计进口和出口多样化对年内粮食价格波动的影响。实证结果表明，更为均衡和多样化的进口组合与更低的粮食价格波动强烈相关，而出口多样化的作用则较为有限。鼓励多样化的政策能够降低粮食价格波动，但需要在国际专业化带来的效率与投入产出网络的韧性之间进行权衡。
title: Trade diversification and food price volatility
title_zh: 贸易多样化与粮食价格波动

abstract: This article is based on several decades of experience engaging in interdisciplinary research and teaching involving agronomists, climate scientists, ecologists, hydrologists and geographers, focused on ensuring the long run sustainability of local and global food systems. Through a series of examples of this research, the paper will underscore several key points. The first is that keeping the economics as simple as possible leaves greater room for interdisciplinary collaboration. The more complex the economic models, the higher the barrier to effective collaboration. Basic economic messages on the role of markets in mediating the impacts of policies, along with producer and consumer responses to changing incentives are invaluable to sustainability analyses and can lend important new insights. This doesn’t mean that the ensuing economic analysis is not sophisticated. Indeed, as will be demonstrated, sophisticated analysis is critically important. But this analysis is at the ‘extensive margin’ of economic science—applying established methods to new application domains. A second point is that economists must work at the same spatial resolution as our science collaborators. For food, land and water sustainability challenges, this is typically the grid cell—geospatial units identified by latitude and longitude coordinates. Economists have been slow on the uptake of the geospatial data revolution. For me personally, this has meant moving, over the last two decades, from national scale general equilibrium modelling to gridded partial equilibrium modelling. Ultimately, these two frameworks can be combined, as I will demonstrate in this paper. Many sustainability analyses must start at the granular level where one can leverage the full expertise of the biophysical scientists. This may take many economists out of their comfort zone. However, our tools can be adapted and brought to bear at fine scale. In this context, the paper highlights the value of the Global‐to‐Local‐to‐Global approach to sustainability analysis. The third key point made in this paper is that economics offers a great organising framework for interdisciplinary projects. Too often we let the biophysical scientists frame the discussion prior to our involvement. This leads to frustration on the part of economists who are relegated to a secondary role in the project. However, if we lead the writing of the proposal and frame the overall discussion in economic terms, this gives rise to a very different dynamic which can facilitate coherent and meaningful economic analyses. Further, when economics is not used in the sustainability sciences, policy prescriptions are often limited at best, and misleading at worst. Finally, I have some suggestions for the teaching of interdisciplinary skills at the graduate level. Here, a well‐constructed course can benefit both the students as well as the instructor, fostering fruitful collaborations on grant applications, as well as generating new ideas for research in the sustainability sciences.
abstract_zh: 本文基于数十年来在农学家、气候科学家、生态学家、水文学家和地理学家共同参与的跨学科研究与教学中的经验，聚焦于确保地方和全球粮食系统的长期可持续性。通过一系列此类研究案例，本文强调若干关键点。第一，尽可能保持经济学的简洁性，可为跨学科合作留出更大空间。经济模型越复杂，有效合作的障碍就越高。关于市场在调节政策影响中的作用，以及生产者和消费者对激励变化的反应等基本经济学信息，对可持续性分析具有重要价值，并能提供重要的新见解。这并不意味着后续的经济分析不复杂。事实上，正如本文将展示的，复杂的分析至关重要。但这种分析处于经济科学的“外延边际”——将既有方法应用于新的领域。第二，经济学家必须与我们的科学合作者采用相同的空间分辨率。对于粮食、土地和水资源可持续性挑战，这通常是网格单元——由纬度和经度坐标确定的地理空间单元。经济学家在地理空间数据革命方面接受较慢。对我个人而言，这意味着在过去二十年中，从国家尺度的一般均衡模型转向网格化的局部均衡模型。最终，这两种框架可以结合起来，正如我将在本文中展示的那样。许多可持续性分析必须从精细层面开始，在那里可以充分利用生物物理科学家的全部专业知识。这可能会让许多经济学家走出舒适区。然而，我们的工具可以调整并应用于精细尺度。在此背景下，本文强调了“全球—地方—全球”方法在可持续性分析中的价值。本文提出的第三个关键点是，经济学为跨学科项目提供了极好的组织框架。我们常常在我们参与之前就让生物物理科学家框定讨论。这导致经济学家感到沮丧，因为他们在项目中被迫扮演次要角色。然而，如果我们主导提案的撰写，并以经济学术语框定整体讨论，就会产生一种非常不同的动态，有助于进行连贯且有意义的的经济分析。此外，当可持续性科学中不使用经济学时，政策建议往好了说往往是有限的，往坏了说则具有误导性。最后，我对研究生阶段的跨学科技能教学提出一些建议。在这里，一门精心设计的课程既能使学生受益，也能使教师受益，促进在资助申请方面的富有成效的合作，并为可持续性科学研究产生新想法。
title: Bridging the Divide Between Agricultural Economics and the Sustainability Sciences
title_zh: 弥合农业经济学与可持续性科学之间的鸿沟

abstract: The centenary of the UK‐based Agricultural Economics Society (AES) is an obvious opportunity to provide an updated summary institutional history of its development and achievements. Knowledge of equivalent associations in the US influenced the foundation of the AES in 1926. After a faltering start, the Society's main activities have been organising residential and one‐day conferences and publishing the Journal of Agricultural Economics . The last‐mentioned began in 1928 as a conference proceedings. Great growth in AES membership occurred in the 25 years after the Second World War, reflecting recognition of the importance of agricultural economics in that era. With the subsequent erosion of the subject's base in British universities, especially around the turn of the millennium, the twenty‐first‐century AES pursued an outward‐looking strategy. It started co‐producing the outreach periodical EuroChoices with the European Association of Agricultural Economists, and holding annual conferences outside Britain. Nowadays AES membership is much more international than in the past but less occupationally diverse, with around three‐quarters of current members drawn from academia. When deemed necessary the Society has occasionally made representations on behalf of the profession, in particular influencing specific aspects of how UK research assessment exercises operate. Numbers of members and annual conference delegates are currently buoyant, and the Executive Committee has launched a £100,000 centenary fund to support postgraduate research students. The AES, then, is well positioned for the opportunities and challenges ahead at the start of its second century.
abstract_zh: 英国农业经济学会（AES）百年华诞，为更新其发展历程与成就的制度史摘要提供了良机。对美国同类学会的了解影响了1926年AES的创立。在起步蹒跚之后，学会的主要活动一直是举办住宿式和单日会议，并出版《农业经济学杂志》。该杂志始于1928年，最初为会议论文集。二战后25年间，AES会员数量大幅增长，反映出当时人们对农业经济学重要性的认可。随着该学科在英国大学中的基础随后遭到侵蚀，尤其是在千年之交前后，21世纪的AES推行了外向型战略。它开始与欧洲农业经济学家协会共同创办外联期刊《EuroChoices》，并在英国以外举行年会。如今，AES会员远比过去国际化，但职业构成多样性下降，目前约四分之三的会员来自学术界。在认为必要时，学会偶尔代表本专业发声，尤其影响了英国研究评估活动的具体运作方式。目前会员人数和年会代表人数均呈上升态势，执行委员会已设立一项10万英镑的百年基金，用于支持研究生。因此，在第二个百年伊始，AES已为未来的机遇与挑战做好了充分准备。
title: A Hundred Years of the Agricultural Economics Society
title_zh: 农业经济学会百年

abstract: We study how firms set wages for their employees when they can legally age-discriminate across workers. We exploit an age-specific minimum wage change in the UK, which raised the minimum applying to workers aged 25 and over, leaving unchanged the minima for younger workers. Using matched employer-employee data on a low-paying sector, we show large, positive wage spillovers on workers aged under 25, which arise within firms from company wage policy. Pay equity norms offer the most parsimonious explanation for the emergence of spillovers. The effects that we document also operate in other low-paying sectors of the UK labor market.
abstract_zh: 我们研究在合法对员工进行年龄歧视的情况下，企业如何设定工资。我们利用英国一项针对特定年龄的最低工资变动，该变动提高了适用于25岁及以上工人的最低工资，而未改变年轻工人的最低工资标准。基于低薪行业的雇主-雇员匹配数据，我们发现在25岁以下工人中存在显著的正向工资溢出效应，这些效应源于企业内部的公司工资政策。薪酬公平规范为溢出效应的产生提供了最简约的解释。我们所记录的影响同样存在于英国劳动力市场的其他低薪行业。

abstract: This paper provides a new approach to estimation and inference in multiple regime panel threshold regression with unobserved individual-specific threshold effects. Such effects are practically relevant and have features that distinguish them from traditional linear panel data models. It is shown that within-regime demeaning in the static model or within-regime first-differencing in the dynamic model both fail to deliver consistent threshold estimators. Instead, correlated random effects models are suggested to address endogeneity in such panel threshold systems. The paper develops a unified framework of estimation and inference for both static and dynamic models that applies irrespective of whether the unobserved individual-specific threshold effects exist or whether the number of regimes is correctly specified. The approach involves model selection based on sequential testing which allows for underestimation of the number of regimes, develops asymptotic theory for least squares estimation that is robust to such model misspecification, and proposes new inferential methods for the model parameters which have improved asymptotic and empirical properties over existing methods. Simulations combined with an empirical application illustrate the practical utility of the new methodology.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种用于估计和推断具有未观测个体特定阈值效应的多机制面板阈值回归的新方法。此类效应在现实中具有相关性，并具有使其区别于传统线性面板数据模型的特征。研究表明，静态模型中的机制内去均值以及动态模型中的机制内一阶差分均无法得到一致的阈值估计量。为此，本文建议采用相关随机效应模型来处理此类面板阈值系统中的内生性。本文为静态模型和动态模型建立了一个统一的估计与推断框架，该框架无论未观测个体特定阈值效应是否存在，或机制数量是否被正确设定，均可适用。该方法涉及基于序贯检验的模型选择，允许机制数量被低估；建立了对此类模型误设定具有稳健性的最小二乘估计渐近理论；并针对模型参数提出了新的推断方法，这些方法在渐近性质和有限样本经验性质上均优于现有方法。模拟结合一项实证应用说明了该新方法的实际效用。
title: Panel threshold regression with unobserved individual-specific threshold effects

abstract: Matching mechanisms that elicit strength of preference can exhibit efficiency gains over those that do not. To quantify these gains, we propose a measure of approximate ex-ante Pareto efficiency. We use this notion to quantify the efficiency improvement of the raffles mechanism (which we define) over the deferred acceptance mechanism (DA). We complement our theoretical analyses with experimental results. Using human subjects, we find that the raffles mechanism yields higher average payoffs as predicted by the theory, despite the fact that subjects play only approximately optimal strategies.
abstract_zh: 能够引出偏好强度的匹配机制，相较于不能引出偏好强度的机制，可能带来效率增益。为量化这些增益，我们提出了一种近似事前帕累托效率的度量。我们运用这一概念来量化抽签机制（由我们定义）相对于延迟接受机制（DA）的效率改进。我们以实验结果补充理论分析。以人类受试者为对象，我们发现，尽管受试者仅采用近似最优策略，抽签机制仍如理论所预测的那样带来了更高的平均收益。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 250
title: Approximately efficient resource allocation: A theoretical and experimental evaluation
title_zh: 近似有效的资源配置：理论与实验评估

abstract: Industrial policy is back on the agenda across advanced economies, with a growing channelling support towards large incumbent firms on the premise that they are the most capable innovators. This column uses data on French manufacturing firms to argue that this premise deserves scrutiny. Firms become large primarily through occasional, large 'innovation bursts' rather than by innovating at persistently higher rates. The arrival of these bursts involves an element of chance, so a firm's current size says little about how much it will innovate in the future. Policies that entrench the position of incumbents may therefore slow down the churn that sustains aggregate growth.
abstract_zh: 产业政策在发达经济体中重新提上议程，越来越多的支持被导向大型在位企业，其前提是这些企业最具创新能力。本专栏利用法国制造业企业的数据论证，这一前提值得审视。企业主要通过偶发的大规模“创新爆发”而非持续更高的创新率而成长为大型企业。这些爆发的到来包含偶然因素，因此企业当前的规模几乎无法说明其未来将有多少创新。那些巩固在位企业地位的政策，可能因此减缓支撑总体增长的更替过程。
authors: Giuseppe Berlingieri, Maarten De Ridder, Danial Lashkari, Davide Rigo
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为法国制造业企业，数据与制度背景均为法国，与中国研究无关。
title: Growth through innovation bursts: Why industrial policy should not bet on size
title_zh: 创新爆发式增长：为何产业政策不应押注规模

abstract: This paper explores whether foreign aid is driven by a (hidden) contest amongst donors to access natural resources, exploiting the timing and size of major mineral discoveries using a gravity model for a large panel of countries. Results show that recipient countries that experience major discoveries receive more, not less, bilateral aid, all else equal. Our main result is not directly but rather indirectly driven by China which entry in the World Trade Organization in 2001 heightened the global competition for access to natural resources. We conclude that the energy transition and its requirement in minerals will further exacerbate the (hidden) contest amongst aid donors.
abstract_zh: 本文利用引力模型，针对大量国家组成的面板数据，考察了主要矿产发现的时机与规模，以探讨外国援助是否由捐助方之间为获取自然资源而展开的（隐性）竞争所驱动。结果表明，在其他条件相同的情况下，经历重大发现的受援国获得的双边援助更多而非更少。我们的主要结果并非直接而是间接由中国驱动，中国于2001年加入世界贸易组织加剧了全球对获取自然资源的竞争。我们得出结论，能源转型及其对矿产的需求将进一步加剧援助捐助方之间的（隐性）竞争。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象是全球援助与矿产资源竞争，中国仅作为间接影响因素提及，并非核心研究对象或数据背景。
title: The (Hidden) Samaritan Contest*
title_zh: （隐藏的）撒玛利亚人竞赛

abstract: This study examines whether geopolitical risk (GPR) affects tax revenue mobilization (TXR) in E7 economies and whether institutional quality (INQ) helps mitigate this effect. Using annual data for China, India, Brazil, Russia, Mexico, Indonesia, and Türkiye over 1985–2024, the study employs the Cross-Sectionally Augmented Autoregressive Distributed Lag (CS-ARDL) estimator, with Fully Modified Ordinary Least Squares (FMOLS) used for robustness. The results indicate that geopolitical risk significantly reduces tax revenue mobilization, while stronger institutional quality improves revenue performance. Moreover, the interaction between GPR and INQ is positive and significant, confirming that institutional quality weakens the adverse effect of geopolitical risk on tax revenue. The findings highlight the importance of institutional capacity in strengthening fiscal resilience and sustaining government financing capacity during periods of geopolitical uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察地缘政治风险（GPR）是否影响E7经济体的税收收入动员（TXR），以及制度质量（INQ）是否有助于缓解这一影响。研究使用中国、印度、巴西、俄罗斯、墨西哥、印度尼西亚和土耳其1985—2024年的年度数据，采用横截面增强自回归分布滞后（CS-ARDL）估计量，并以完全修正普通最小二乘法（FMOLS）进行稳健性检验。结果表明，地缘政治风险显著降低税收收入动员，而更强的制度质量则改善收入表现。此外，GPR与INQ的交互项为正且显著，证实制度质量削弱了地缘政治风险对税收收入的不利影响。研究结果凸显了在地缘政治不确定时期，制度能力对于增强财政韧性和维持政府融资能力的重要性。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象包含中国，使用中国1985-2024年数据，属于E7经济体之一，与中国研究直接相关。
title: Geopolitical Risk and Fiscal Financing Capacity in E7 Economies: Does Institutional Quality Matter?
title_zh: 地缘政治风险与E7经济体的财政融资能力：制度质量是否重要？

abstract: This paper studies mandatory job-search periods for welfare applicants. During this period the benefits application is put on hold and the applicant is obliged to make job applications. We combine a randomized experiment with detailed administrative data to investigate the effects of imposing a job-search period. We find strong and persistent effects on the probability to collect welfare benefits. The reduced benefits are fully compensated by increased earnings from work. Furthermore, we do not find evidence of adverse consequences for the most vulnerable applicants. Our results therefore suggest that a job-search period is an effective instrument for targeting welfare-benefits applicants.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了福利申请人的强制性求职期。在此期间，福利申请被暂停，申请人必须进行求职。我们将随机实验与详细的行政数据相结合，考察施加求职期的影响。我们发现，这对领取福利金的概率产生了强烈且持续的影响。减少的福利金完全由工作收入的增加所补偿。此外，我们未发现对最脆弱申请人产生不利后果的证据。因此，我们的结果表明，求职期是瞄准福利金申请人的一种有效工具。
title: Job-Search Periods for Welfare Applicants: Evidence from a Randomized Experiment
title_zh: 福利申请者的求职期：来自随机实验的证据

abstract: It takes a woman and a man to make a baby. This fact suggests that for a birth to take place, the parents should first agree on wanting a child. Using newly available data on fertility preferences and outcomes, we show that indeed, babies are likely to arrive only if both parents desire one. In addition, there are many couples who disagree on having babies, and in low-fertility countries women are much more likely than men to be opposed to having another child. We account for this evidence with a quantitative model of household bargaining in which the distribution of the burden of child care between mothers and fathers is a key determinant of fertility. The model implies that fertility is highly responsive to targeted policies that lower the child care burden specifically for mothers.
abstract_zh: 生儿育女需要男女双方共同参与。这一事实表明，一个孩子的诞生，首先需要父母双方在想要孩子这件事上达成一致。利用新近可得的生育偏好与生育结果数据，我们证明，孩子的到来确实往往以父母双方都想要孩子为前提。此外，许多夫妻在是否生育孩子上存在分歧，而在低生育率国家，女性比男性更可能反对再生育一个孩子。我们用一个家庭议价的量化模型来解释这些证据，其中父母之间育儿负担的分配是生育率的关键决定因素。该模型意味着，生育率对那些专门降低母亲育儿负担的针对性政策高度敏感。
title: Bargaining over Babies: Theory, Evidence, and Policy Implications
title_zh: 为婴儿讨价还价：理论、证据与政策含义

abstract: An expert with general knowledge trains a cash-constrained novice. Faster training increases the novices productivity and his ability to compensate the expert; it also shrinks the stock of knowledge yet to be transferred, reducing the experts ability to retain the novice. The pro t-maximizing agreement is a multi-period apprenticeship in which knowledge is transferred gradually over time. The expert adopts a ¹/ₑ rulewhereby, at the beginning of the relationship, the novice is trained just enough to produce a fraction ¹/ₑ of the efficient output. This rule causes inefficiently lengthy relationships that grow longer the more patient the players. We discuss policy interventions.
abstract_zh: 一位具备通用知识的专家培训一位受现金约束的新手。培训速度越快，新手生产率及其补偿专家的能力提升得越快；同时，尚待转移的知识存量也会缩小，从而削弱专家留住新手的能力。利润最大化的协议是一种多期学徒制，知识随时间逐步转移。专家采用“1/e规则”，即在关系开始时，对新手的培训刚好足以使其产出达到有效产出的1/e。该规则导致关系长度低效地延长，且参与者越有耐心，关系持续越久。我们讨论了政策干预。
title: Relational Knowledge Transfers
title_zh: 关系性知识转移

abstract: This paper studies a natural experiment: the end of the “professor’s privilege” in Norway, where university researchers previously enjoyed full rights to their innovations. Upon the reform, Norway moved toward the typical U.S. model, where the university holds majority rights. Using comprehensive data on Norwegian workers, firms, and patents, we find a 50% decline in both entrepreneurship and patenting rates by university researchers after the reform. Quality measures for university start-ups and patents also decline. Applications to literatures on university technology transfer, innovation incentives, and taxes and entrepreneurship are considered.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一项自然实验：挪威“教授特权”的终结，此前大学研究人员对其创新成果享有完全权利。改革后，挪威转向了典型的美国模式，即大学持有大部分权利。利用关于挪威工人、企业和专利的全面数据，我们发现改革后大学研究人员的创业率和专利率均下降了50%。大学初创企业和专利的质量指标也有所下降。本文还探讨了对大学技术转移、创新激励以及税收与创业等文献的贡献。
title: University Innovation and the Professor’s Privilege
title_zh: 大学创新与教授特权

abstract: We estimate the net effects of migration from Malawi to South African mines using newly digitized Census and administrative data on access to mine jobs, a difference-in-differences strategy and two opposite-signed and plausibly exogenous shocks to the option to migrate. Twenty years after these shocks, human capital is 4.8-6.9% higher among cohorts who were eligible for schooling in communities with the easiest access to migrant jobs.
abstract_zh: 我们利用新数字化的普查数据和关于获得矿场工作机会的行政数据，采用双重差分策略以及两个方向相反且看似外生的移民选择冲击，估计了从马拉维向南非矿场移民的净效应。在这些冲击发生二十年后，在那些最容易获得移民工作机会的社区中，有资格接受教育的 cohorts 的人力资本高出4.8%至6.9%。
title: The long run effects of labor migration on human capital formation in communities of origin
title_zh: 劳动力迁移对来源社区人力资本形成的长期影响
